{"notes": "Visit 4 (ended 6:00). Picture: the gap near (22, 11.5) is closed. One dark chain now runs from START (16, 14.8) around the belly, head, top line and down the join to the lower tail fin (~24.5, 13). START is stable at (16, 14.8), so my earlier (27.3, 4.1) note was probably a misread of the tail tip. Only the upper tail fin (22.7, 8.3 to 27.3, 4.1) is still pale and disconnected, and it will not fall as it stands. I can't tell who placed which domino, so I'm crediting no one with closing the gap.

Maya: Not seen or heard this visit. No new evidence, still unrated. Ask her where her line ends.

Priya: Said her tail stroke runs to the same spot as Leo's bridge and asked Leo to hold off and check once she's through. She also asked Tom to check her joint with Maya's. Clear communication, but that's a statement. I can't say her stroke is what closed the gap. The upper tail is still open. Ask her.

Tom: Priya asked him again to check the Priya/Maya joint. I still haven't seen him do it or say anything. No evidence either way. Ask what he tested.

Leo: Said his bridge is down but the last dominoes sat off to the side, and he was nudging them into line at the end of Priya's line. Good that he spotted and owned the misalignment. But he and Priya both claimed the same spot, with slightly different plans (hold off vs. go ahead). Nudging near a live line risks toppling it. I can't confirm whose work is in the join.

Next visit: check the upper tail fin is connected, who closed the gap, and whether Priya and Leo have settled one plan for the join."}
